q: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem, who came from the east to find Him?
why: They came looking for the newborn King of the Jews.
quote: Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem

q: What did the Magi see in the east that led them to look for the newborn King?
why: They came to worship Him.
quote: We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.

q: What gifts did the Magi give the Child Jesus?
why: They fell down and worshiped Him.
quote: gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.

q: After the Magi left, where did an angel tell Joseph to flee with baby Jesus?
why: King Herod wanted to kill the Child.
quote: Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt.

q: What did John the Baptist preach in the wilderness of Judea?
why: He prepared the way for Jesus.
quote: Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.

q: What did John the Baptist eat in the wilderness?
why: He lived a simple life in the desert.
quote: His food was locusts and wild honey.

q: What were John the Baptist's clothes made of?
why: He wore a leather belt too.
quote: John wore a garment of camel’s hair

q: In which river did John the Baptist baptize the people?
why: People came confessing their sins.
quote: they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

q: When Jesus was baptized, what came down on Him like a dove?
why: The heavens opened as He came out of the water.
quote: He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.

q: After John baptized Jesus in the Jordan, what did God's voice from heaven say?
why: God the Father was well pleased with Jesus.
quote: This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!

q: When Jesus came to be baptized, what did John the Baptist first say?
a: I need to be baptized by You
why: John knew Jesus was greater than he.
quote: I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?

q: Where was Jesus led by the Spirit to be tempted by the devil?
why: This happened right after His baptism.
quote: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

q: How long did Jesus fast in the wilderness before He was tempted?
why: Afterward He was hungry.
quote: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.

q: In the wilderness, what did the devil tell hungry Jesus to turn stones into?
why: Jesus answered with God's word.
quote: tell these stones to become bread.

q: Tempted in the wilderness, Jesus said man shall not live on bread alone, but on what?
why: God's word is real food for the soul.
quote: but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.

q: When tempting Jesus, where did the devil set Him and tell Him to jump?
why: Jesus would not test God.
quote: and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.

q: From a very high mountain, what did the devil show Jesus to tempt Him?
a: All the kingdoms of the world
why: He offered them if Jesus would worship him.
quote: showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

q: After the devil left Jesus in the wilderness, who came and served Him?
why: Jesus had defeated every temptation.
quote: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.

q: In the Beatitudes, who will see God?
why: Jesus taught this in the Sermon on the Mount.
quote: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

q: In the Beatitudes, who will be called sons of God?
why: God's children make peace.
quote: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.

q: In the Beatitudes, what will the meek inherit?
why: Gentle people are blessed.
quote: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.

q: In the Beatitudes, what does Jesus promise to those who mourn?
why: God comforts the sad.
quote: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

q: In the Beatitudes, who will be shown mercy?
why: Those who show mercy receive mercy.
quote: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

q: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus calls His followers the salt of what?
why: Salt gives flavor and keeps food from spoiling.
quote: You are the salt of the earth.

q: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus calls His followers the light of what?
why: A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
quote: You are the light of the world.

q: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus said people do not put a lamp under what?
why: A lamp is meant to give light to everyone.
quote: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket.

q: How does the Lord's Prayer begin?
why: Jesus taught us to pray to God as Father.
quote: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.

q: In the Lord's Prayer, where do we ask for God's will to be done as it is in heaven?
why: We pray for God's kingdom to come.
quote: Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

q: In the Lord's Prayer, what do we ask God to give us this day?
why: We trust God for what we need each day.
quote: Give us this day our daily bread.

q: In the Lord's Prayer, we ask God to forgive our debts as we have done what?
why: Forgiven people forgive others.
quote: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

q: In the Lord's Prayer, from whom do we ask God to deliver us?
why: We also ask not to be led into temptation.
quote: but deliver us from the evil one.

q: In the Lord's Prayer, what do we say about God's name?
why: Hallowed means honored as holy.
quote: hallowed be Your name.

q: In Jesus' story of two builders, where did the wise man build his house?
why: A strong foundation keeps the house standing.
quote: is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

q: In Jesus' story of two builders, where did the foolish man build his house?
why: Sand cannot hold a house in a storm.
quote: is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

q: In Jesus' story of two builders, why did the wise man's house stand through the storm?
a: Its foundation was on the rock
why: Obeying Jesus is like building on rock.
quote: yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.

q: In Jesus' story of two builders, what happened to the house on sand?
a: It fell with a great crash
why: Hearing without doing leads to ruin.
quote: and it fell—and great was its collapse!

q: In Jesus' story of two builders, the wise man is like someone who hears Jesus' words and does what?
why: Doing what Jesus says is wise.
quote: everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man

q: In Jesus' story of two builders, what beat against the house on the rock?
why: Storms come to everyone.
quote: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house

q: How did Jesus come to His disciples' boat in the middle of the night?
why: He has power over the sea.
quote: Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.

q: When the disciples saw Jesus walking on the sea, what did they think He was?
why: They cried out in fear.
quote: “It’s a ghost!” they said

q: Walking on the water, what did Jesus tell His frightened disciples?
why: He told them not to be afraid.
quote: Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.

q: Which disciple got out of the boat and walked on the water toward Jesus?
why: Jesus told him, “Come.”
quote: Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.

q: Why did Peter begin to sink while walking on the water?
a: He saw the wind and was afraid
why: He took his eyes off Jesus.
quote: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid

q: As Peter began to sink in the sea, what did he cry out?
why: Jesus reached out and caught him.
quote: cried out, “Lord, save me!”

q: After Jesus walked on the water and the wind stopped, what did the disciples say?
a: Truly You are the Son of God
why: They worshiped Him in the boat.
quote: Truly You are the Son of God!

q: In Jesus' parable of the sower, what ate the seed that fell on the path?
why: The seed never had a chance to grow.
quote: some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.

q: In the parable of the sower, why did the seedlings on rocky ground wither?
why: The soil was too shallow.
quote: and they withered because they had no root.

q: In the parable of the sower, what happened to the seed that fell among thorns?
why: The thorns grew up around it.
quote: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.

q: In the parable of the sower, what did the seed on good soil do?
why: Good soil is like a heart that receives God's word.
quote: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop

q: Explaining the sower, Jesus said the good soil is someone who hears the word and does what?
why: God's word grows in a ready heart.
quote: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit

q: Explaining the sower, what did Jesus say the thorns stand for?
why: They choke God's word in our hearts.
quote: but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word

q: Jesus said the kingdom of heaven is like which tiny seed?
why: Small beginnings can grow very large.
quote: The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man planted in his field.

q: In Jesus' parable, what does the tiny mustard seed grow into?
why: It becomes the largest of garden plants.
quote: and becomes a tree

q: In Jesus' parable of the mustard seed, who comes to nest in its branches?
why: The kingdom grows big enough to shelter many.
quote: so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.

q: In Jesus' parable, how does the mustard seed compare with other seeds?
why: Yet it grows into something great.
quote: Although it is the smallest of all seeds

q: In Jesus' parable of the ten virgins, whom did they go out to meet?
why: They took their lamps to meet him.
quote: took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

q: In the parable of the ten virgins, how many of them were wise?
why: The other five were foolish.
quote: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

q: In the parable of the ten virgins, what did the wise ones bring with their lamps?
why: They were ready for a long wait.
quote: But the wise ones took oil in flasks along with their lamps.

q: In the parable of the ten virgins, what happened when the bridegroom was late?
why: All ten became drowsy.
quote: they all became drowsy and fell asleep.

q: In the parable of the ten virgins, when did the cry ring out that the bridegroom was coming?
why: He came when they did not expect.
quote: At midnight the cry rang out

q: In the parable of the ten virgins, what happened after the ready ones went in to the feast?
why: The foolish ones were too late.
quote: and the door was shut.

q: What lesson did Jesus give at the end of the parable of the ten virgins?
why: No one knows the day or the hour.
quote: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.

q: In Jesus' parable of the talents, how many talents did the first servant receive?
why: Each got an amount based on his ability.
quote: To one he gave five talents

q: In the parable of the talents, what did the servant with one talent do with it?
why: He did nothing with what he was given.
quote: dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.

q: In the parable of the talents, what did the master say to the servants who gained more?
a: Well done, good and faithful servant
why: Faithfulness with a little brings more.
quote: Well done, good and faithful servant!

q: In the parable of the talents, how many more talents did the five-talent servant gain?
why: He put the money to work at once.
quote: went at once and put them to work and gained five more.

q: In the parable of the talents, why did the one-talent servant say he hid the money?
why: Fear kept him from using what he had.
quote: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground.

q: In the parable of the talents, who received the talent taken from the fearful servant?
why: Those who use what they have are given more.
quote: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.

q: Before entering Jerusalem, what animals did Jesus send two disciples to bring?
why: The King came humbly on a donkey.
quote: you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt beside her.

q: As Jesus rode into Jerusalem, what did the crowd spread on the road?
why: They welcomed Him like a king.
quote: A massive crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees

q: As Jesus rode into Jerusalem, what did the crowds shout?
a: Hosanna to the Son of David!
why: They praised Him as the promised King.
quote: Hosanna to the Son of David!

q: After entering Jerusalem, whose tables did Jesus overturn in the temple courts?
why: They had turned God's house into a market.
quote: He overturned the tables of the money changers

q: When Jesus cleared the temple, He said His house should be called a house of what?
why: They had made it a den of robbers.
quote: My house will be called a house of prayer.

q: On which mount was Bethphage, where Jesus stopped before entering Jerusalem?
why: From there He sent two disciples ahead.
quote: came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives

q: Where did Jesus go to pray with His disciples on the night He was arrested?
why: He prayed there before the cross.
quote: Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane

q: In Gethsemane, Jesus prayed, “Yet not as I will, but…” what?
why: Jesus obeyed His Father completely.
quote: Yet not as I will, but as You will.

q: When Jesus came back from praying in Gethsemane, what were His disciples doing?
why: They could not keep watch for one hour.
quote: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping.

q: In Gethsemane, Jesus said the spirit is willing, but what is weak?
why: He told them to watch and pray.
quote: For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.

q: In Gethsemane, how did Judas show the crowd which one was Jesus?
why: It was the signal he had arranged.
quote: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.

q: In Gethsemane, what was the crowd that came with Judas carrying?
why: The chief priests had sent them.
quote: accompanied by a large crowd armed with swords and clubs

q: In Gethsemane, which disciples did Jesus take farther with Him?
why: He was deeply sorrowful.
quote: He took with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee

q: In the Great Commission, Jesus told His followers to make disciples of whom?
why: The good news is for the whole world.
quote: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations

q: In the Great Commission, in whose name are new disciples baptized?
why: One God in three persons.
quote: baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit

q: In the Great Commission, how long did Jesus promise to be with His disciples?
a: To the end of the age
why: Jesus is always with His people.
quote: And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.

q: Before giving the Great Commission, what did Jesus say had been given to Him?
a: All authority in heaven and earth
why: His command comes with full authority.
quote: All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.

q: In the Great Commission, what were the disciples to teach new believers?
why: Disciples learn to live Jesus' way.
quote: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you.

q: Matthew says the virgin's son would be called Immanuel. What does Immanuel mean?
why: Jesus is God come to be with His people.
quote: (which means, “God with us”).

q: When Jesus called Peter and Andrew by the Sea of Galilee, what did He say He would make them?
why: They would bring people to Jesus.
quote: and I will make you fishers of men.

q: When Jesus called Peter and Andrew, what did they leave behind right away?
why: They followed Him at once.
quote: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.

q: In the Sermon on the Mount, what did Jesus tell us to do for our enemies?
a: Love them and pray for them
why: God's love reaches even enemies.
quote: love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you

q: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus said where your treasure is, there your what will be also?
why: What we value shows what we love.
quote: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

q: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus said you cannot serve both God and what?
why: No one can serve two masters.
quote: You cannot serve both God and money.

q: Teaching about worry, which creatures did Jesus point to as fed by God without sowing or reaping?
why: We are worth much more to God than birds.
quote: Look at the birds of the air

q: In the Sermon on the Mount, what did Jesus say to seek first?
why: Then all these things will be added.
quote: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness

q: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus said not to worry about what?
why: Each day has enough trouble of its own.
quote: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow

q: Jesus said ask and it will be given, seek and you will find, and knock and what?
why: God answers those who seek Him.
quote: knock, and the door will be opened to you.

q: What did Jesus say is the essence of the Law and the Prophets?
why: This is often called the Golden Rule.
quote: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you.

q: Where was Matthew sitting when Jesus called him to follow?
why: Matthew got up and followed Jesus.
quote: He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth.

q: In Jesus' parable, the kingdom of heaven is like what hidden in a field?
why: The man sold everything to buy the field.
quote: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field.

q: In Jesus' parable, what did the merchant sell everything he had to buy?
why: God's kingdom is worth everything.
quote: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.

q: Before Jesus fed the five thousand, what food did the disciples have?
why: It was not nearly enough for the crowd.
quote: We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish

q: After Jesus fed the five thousand, how many baskets of leftovers were picked up?
why: Everyone ate and was satisfied.
quote: the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

q: When Jesus asked, “Who do you say I am?”, what did Peter answer?
a: The Christ, Son of the living God
why: God the Father had shown this to Peter.
quote: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

q: When Jesus was transfigured on the mountain, what did His face shine like?
why: His clothes became white as light.
quote: His face shone like the sun

q: When Peter asked if he should forgive his brother seven times, what did Jesus answer?
why: Forgiveness should have no limit.
quote: not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!

q: Jesus said it is easier for a camel to go through what than for a rich man to enter God's kingdom?
why: Riches can keep people from God.
quote: it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle

q: What did Jesus call the first and greatest commandment?
a: Love God with all your heart
why: Love God with all your heart, soul, and mind.
quote: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.

q: What did Jesus say is the second commandment, like the first?
why: Love for God shows in love for people.
quote: Love your neighbor as yourself.

q: How much did the chief priests pay Judas to hand Jesus over?
why: Judas betrayed Jesus for money.
quote: And they set out for him thirty pieces of silver.

q: At the Last Supper, what did Jesus say as He gave the disciples the broken bread?
a: Take and eat; this is My body
why: His body would be given for them.
quote: Take and eat; this is My body.

q: After denying Jesus three times, what did Peter do when the rooster crowed?
why: He remembered what Jesus had said.
quote: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

q: Before handing Jesus over to be crucified, what did Pilate do in front of the crowd?
why: He said he was innocent of this man's blood.
quote: he took water and washed his hands before the crowd.

q: When Jesus died on the cross, what happened to the veil of the temple?
why: It tore from top to bottom.
quote: At that moment the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

q: After the earthquake at the cross, what did the centurion guarding Jesus say?
a: Truly this was the Son of God
why: Even a Roman soldier saw who Jesus was.
quote: Truly this was the Son of God.

q: Where did Joseph of Arimathea place the body of Jesus?
why: He rolled a great stone across the entrance.
quote: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock.

q: At the empty tomb, what did the angel tell the women about Jesus?
a: He is not here; He has risen
why: Jesus rose just as He said.
quote: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said!

q: On the morning Jesus rose, who rolled away the stone from the tomb?
why: There was a great earthquake.
quote: for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.

q: John the Baptist said he was not worthy to carry what of the One coming after him?
why: John knew Jesus was far greater.
quote: whose sandals I am not worthy to carry.

q: John the Baptist said the One after him would baptize with the Holy Spirit and with what?
why: John baptized only with water.
quote: He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

q: When the devil told Jesus to jump from the temple, what Scripture did Jesus answer with?
a: Do not put God to the test
wrong: Man shall not live on bread
why: Jesus would not force God to prove Himself.
quote: Do not put the Lord your God to the test.

q: In Matthew's list of the twelve apostles, what is Matthew called?
why: He had worked at a tax booth.
quote: Thomas and Matthew the tax collector

q: In Matthew's list of the twelve apostles, which other Simon is named besides Peter?
why: He is listed near Judas Iscariot.
quote: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot

q: In the parable of the sower, what yields did the seed on good soil produce?
why: Good soil bears a rich harvest.
quote: a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.

q: During which watch of the night did Jesus walk on the sea to His disciples?
why: It was in the early morning darkness.
quote: During the fourth watch of the night

q: About how many men were fed with five loaves and two fish, besides women and children?
why: Women and children ate too.
quote: About five thousand men were fed

q: When Peter confessed Jesus as the Christ, what full name did Jesus call him?
why: Jesus said the Father had revealed this to him.
quote: Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah!

q: Which three disciples went up the high mountain where Jesus was transfigured?
why: They saw Jesus' glory.
quote: Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James

q: Clearing the temple, besides the money changers' tables, whose seats did Jesus overturn?
why: He drove out all who were buying and selling.
quote: and the seats of those selling doves.

q: In the parable of the talents, how many talents did the second servant receive?
why: He gained two more.
quote: to another two talents

q: At the crucifixion, darkness covered the land from which hour to which hour?
why: Then Jesus cried out with a loud voice.
quote: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.

q: In Matthew, what did Jesus cry out in a loud voice about the ninth hour on the cross?
why: It means, My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?
quote: “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?”

q: Joseph, the rich disciple who buried Jesus, came from which town?
why: He asked Pilate for Jesus' body.
quote: there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph

q: At Jesus' tomb, what did the angel's clothes look like?
why: His appearance was like lightning.
quote: and his clothes were white as snow.
